claim: Bounded contextual candidate compilation, scoped current-turn selection, session request inclusion history and restore-safe individual suppression. Full Discovery and Initiative remain incomplete.
verifiedComponentBehavior: Preparation atomically publishes a current TopicBrief or tentative hypothesis with schema-validated, scoped candidates. Candidates expire within ten minutes and no later than their prepared parent.
Candidate publication rejects unavailable parents, expired or mismatched dependencies, invalid lifetime and suppressed identities or matching fingerprints.

Live optional lookup reads at most 32 indexed rows; explicit topic matches precede weaker lexical overlap. An explicitly named domain withholds mismatched topic candidates. Current correction wording withholds optional enrichment.

Authenticated synthetic provider-request inspection confirms the current domain detail is included and the alternate-domain detail excluded. A repeated request in the same session excludes the already-submitted candidate.
Typed and voice provider calls share bounded inclusion bookkeeping. Inclusion is not reported as generation, delivery, consumption or model use.
Individual suppression records a minimal owner-local journal intent before SQLite application. Failed storage application withholds affected use and accepts an identical retry.
Restoring the pre-suppression database reapplies suppression before use. Supporting source briefs remain retained. Scope and retry conflicts fail closed.
The browser workflow exposes separate candidate records with full identifiers, expiry, grounding, uncertainty, alternatives and independent scores. Unknown scores remain visibly unknown.
Preview and confirmation identify the selected candidate and revision. A suppressed record stays visible and unavailable for selection. Mobile capture was visually inspected.
limitations: Input and recovery checks use synthetic material and a fixture provider. No selected-provider model behavior or physical voice delivery is certified.

Selection is bounded lexical and explicit-topic matching, not a general semantic domain resolver. Multi-domain ambiguity, richer candidate kinds, personal-interest strength, calibrated scoring and exploration allocation remain incomplete.
Candidate suppression fingerprints detect matching structured content and pinned source/evidence versions, not semantic paraphrases.

Session inclusion history is volatile and bounded to 128 scope/session entries and 32 identifiers per entry. It records attempted provider submission, not successful output; it does not provide durable cross-session repetition policy.

Existing topic briefs remain inspectable, but legacy brief projections are withheld from the new candidate-only selector until preparation is explicitly rerun. Mandatory relationship context remains available.
Suppression advances the existing recovery boundary, conservatively withholding other derived suggestions until rebuilt while retaining their source evidence.

Live model analysis admission, isolated Discovery Lab, S083 opportunity/output lifecycle, corpus/provider/voice performance qualification and current-source prerequisite successor receipts remain pending.
No saved review service restart, live configuration, personal-data import, network research, provider selection, training or new Human acceptance occurred.
